paragraphs.text:
You pack what remains of your belongings into your thin 
briefcase and leave your room behind. You descend the staircase, 
ignoring the sound of the other guests in their rooms. When 
you reach the establishment’s doorway, you peer out the nearby 
window and into the sickly fog.
